Metadata.title: Fatma Kahraman
Metadata.description: Architect / Project Management Professional — over 25 years of design and project management on large-scale Design & Build projects.

Home.heroAlt: Qatar National Convention Centre — the Sidra tree entrance structure
Home.statement: I believe that design is a never-ending journey from the first day's sketch to the day the last nail is hammered, and on through the user's operation of the building. All design disciplines must work in such harmony that the overall experience puts the customer first.
Home.statementSecondary: Over twenty-five years with real estate developers, contractors and designers on large-scale Design & Build projects have taught me that solution-oriented approaches and measurable technical methods, shared between stakeholders and engineering disciplines, push the project life cycle towards a more efficient future.
Home.signature: Because a building is designed until it is built.

Practice.title: Practice
Practice.intro: There are architects who draw, and there are architects who make sure the drawing gets built. Fatma Kahraman has spent more than twenty-five years doing both — on airports, convention centres, mixed-use districts, hotels and headquarters across Türkiye, the Gulf and Central Asia.

design.label: Design
design.body: I started my professional journey with Prof. Dr. Fatih Gorbon, one of my professors at Mimar Sinan University. We entered architectural competitions together and designed and produced yacht projects. This taught me design.

coordination.label: Project Coordination & Detail Design
coordination.body: Afterwards I gained technical depth and advanced CAD experience preparing the detail and issue-for-construction drawings of large-scale international projects at Turgut Alton Architecture. This experience became the foundation of my later success in project management. This taught me project coordination, detail design and advanced CAD.

management.label: Project & Construction Management
management.body: After 2009 I decided to move to the other side of the table and began working for real estate developers and contractors in the project and design management of large-scale projects abroad. This taught me project management and construction management.

profile.name: Fatma Kahraman
profile.credentials:
B.Arch, Mimar Sinan University, 1993
PMI Project Management Professional, License 08/195
profile.quote: Design is a never-ending journey from the first day's sketch to the day the last nail is hammered — and on through the user's operation phase.
profile.body: Fatma's approach is formed by having worked on every side of a project: as a designer producing competition entries and yachts, as a lead architect drawing construction documents for palaces, hotels and a convention centre, and as a design manager, project coordinator and director of design for contractors and developers on airports, headquarters and mixed-use districts. She has led architectural coordination groups of more than thirty specialists, interior architecture teams of thirteen and design and BIM departments at group headquarters level.

Projects.title: Selected Projects
Projects.intro: A curated selection of projects — the ones that tell the story of how Fatma works. From a palace on the Bosphorus and a convention centre in Doha to international airports and a city-scale mixed-use district, this portfolio follows each project through design, coordination and construction, and the role she played in it.

Experience.title: Experience & Education
Experience.intro: Thirty years of professional experience, from an architectural office in Istanbul to design and project management for the largest developers and contractors in the region — and the education and certification that underpin it.

Approach.title: Project Management
Approach.intro: Every project follows the same life cycle: development, design, construction and operation. The difference lies in how each phase is planned, who is coordinated and what is documented. This is the framework Fatma applies across all disciplines — from feasibility to hand-over.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.intro: We’re always happy to hear from people who are interested in our work. If you have a query about potential projects, collaborations or are simply curious about design, please feel free to get in touch.
